visual_goal: Show a journey from a business event through hops held together by one identifier chain, to evidence at the end, measured by a journey owner who owns recovery.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Far left: a lightning-bolt event marker labeled 'Business event'. One arrow into a row of three linked boxes inside one rounded frame labeled 'Hops'; a single small tag shaped like a luggage tag passes along the row from box to box, labeled 'identifier'. One arrow from the last hop to a checkmarked seal on a document labeled 'Evidence'. One arrow from 'Evidence' up to a person with a stopwatch labeled 'Journey owner', with the arrow labeled 'measured end to end'. One arrow from 'Journey owner' down-left to a toolbox labeled 'Recovery', labeled 'failure table'. One arrow from 'Recovery' back into the 'Hops' frame. These six labels plus the two arrow labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A business event starts a row of hops linked by one identifier tag; the last hop reaches evidence, a journey owner measures end to end, and recovery feeds back into the hops.
